localChanges: In Civilization II games, the build list, the city screen and the Wonders report show Civilization II's own pictures of improvements and Wonders. Import ICONS.GIF again to get them (closes #1052).

The food, shield, trade, gold, luxury and science symbols are Civilization II's too: in the top bar, the city screen's yields, the markers under supported units and the build list's costs (closes #1054).
The citizens in a Civilization II game's windows are its own people, in the reports' headings and the notices as well as the city screen, once PEOPLE.GIF is imported (#1165).
In these windows, where Civilization II has no symbol or citizen of its own, civ.one's own pixel art is shown where it has one.

log: Cut Civ2's improvement and Wonder pictures and the research and warming meters from ICONS.GIF (#7)
